signature.name: VTask.truncLT
signature.type: {Γ : Type u_1} -> {R : Type u_3} -> [Zero R] -> [PartialOrder Γ] -> [DecidableLT Γ] -> (c : Γ) -> ZeroHom (HahnSeries Γ R) (HahnSeries Γ R)

conventions.statement: The coefficient at index exactly equal to `c` is zeroed out, because the retention condition is the strict inequality `i < c`.
conventions.note: Strict less-than means the cutoff index itself is on the killed side.

conventions.point: incomparable indices in a partial order
conventions.statement: For an index `i` that is incomparable to `c` in the partial order (neither `i < c` holds), the coefficient at `i` is set to zero.
conventions.note: The test `i < c` fails for incomparable elements, so they are treated like indices ≥ c.

facts.statement: ∀ {Γ : Type*} {R : Type*} [Zero R] [PartialOrder Γ] [DecidableLT Γ] (c : Γ), VTask.truncLT c (0 : HahnSeries Γ R) = 0

facts.statement: ∀ {Γ : Type*} {R : Type*} [Zero R] [PartialOrder Γ] [DecidableLT Γ] (c : Γ), (VTask.truncLT c).toFun (0 : HahnSeries Γ R) = 0

facts.statement: ∀ (x : HahnSeries ℤ ℚ), (VTask.truncLT (0 : ℤ) x).coeff 0 ≠ x.coeff 0 ∨ x.coeff 0 = 0
